When measured, use #10 THHN/THWN Cu H/N/G for scheduled receptacle circuits and 1HD-21, and #12 THHN/THWN Cu H/N/G for 1LH-11. Multiply route footage by each conductor count; provide individual neutrals and required essential-branch segregation.
